marc:datafield.marc:subfield: The prince, the Princess and the Bee

When a new bee princess, Honey is born in Sunny Patch, Shimmer (a jewel beetle adopted by the Spider family) discovers from a visiting beetle royalty that she may be a princess. She learns the story of a long-lost jewel beetle princess who was carried away on the wind. Told that she can find out for sure if she attends the Big Beetle Ball in Mushroom Glen, she begs her adopted parents, Miss Spider and Holley to let her attend. While Shimmer's adopted family continue to love her unconditionally, the kids realise that you don't have to be a prince or a princess to feel like royalty
